description: This file is part of a TinyMCE plugin called 'xhtmlxtras', specifically for 'cite' elements. It contains HTML markup, JavaScript references, and embedded client-side scripting for a configuration dialog in the TinyMCE editor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function invoked on page load to set up the plugin dialog.

methods.name: insertCite
methods.description: Function to insert a cite element into the TinyMCE editor.

methods.name: removeCite
methods.description: Function to remove a cite element from the editor.
